title: Sign in
identifier_body: Enter your account name to continue. If your account is held by a partner provider, you will be taken there to enter your password.
password_body: Enter the password for this account. You are signing in at the provider shown above.
identifier_hint: Your username, or username@domain if your account is held by another provider.
recovery_help: Forgot your password? Ask your administrator to send a reset link to the email address on your account. Reset links expire. If yours has, ask for a new one.
recovery_admin: Only an administrator can send a reset link. You choose your new password yourself through that link. If no email arrives, check your spam folder before asking again.
passkey_status: Follow the prompt from your browser or device.
invitation_info: Accounts are by invitation only. If you need one, contact your administrator.
generic_error: We couldn't sign you in with that account and password. Check your password and try again, or ask your administrator for a reset link.
identifier_error: Enter your username, or username@domain if your account is held by another provider.
unknown_provider: Accounts from that domain can't sign in here. Check the part after @, or enter just your username if your account is held by this provider.
no_auth_request: This sign-in request is missing or has expired. Go back to the app or site you were using and start signing in again.
passkey_unavailable: Passkeys aren't available in this browser. Sign in with your password instead.
passkey_failed: Passkey sign-in didn't complete. Try again, or sign in with your password.
continuation_body: Sign-in isn't finished yet. Your browser should continue on its own. If nothing happens, select Continue.
